recommends.title: Streamline Flow Transition
recommends.suggestion: This step shows significant drop-off. Ensure page navigation is smooth and there is no sudden change in tone or visual style.

recommends.title: Revise Copy and Hook
recommends.suggestion: Your initial teaser has a high drop-off of ${change}%. Test bold value statements (e.g.,'Unlock 10% Off Now') instead of neutral descriptions.

recommends.title: Adjust Trigger Behavior
recommends.suggestion: Instead of showing the teaser instantly, wait for a 5-second delay or 20% scroll depth to ensure visitors are engaged first.

recommends.title: Maximize Offer Value
recommends.suggestion: An exit-intent popup is your last opportunity to save the session. Losing ${change}% of users implies the reward is not strong enough to stop them from leaving. Try offering a slightly higher discount or a unique perk (e.g., free shipping) to sweeten the deal.

recommends.title: Introduce FOMO and Urgency
recommends.suggestion: Since visitors are actively trying to close the tab, add micro-copy like 'This offer expires in 10 minutes' or 'Only valid for your current session' to discourage them from clicking away to compare prices.

recommends.title: Add One-Click Auto-Copy
recommends.suggestion: You are losing ${change}% of highly motivated users at the end. Use a distinct button that automatically copies the coupon to the clipboard.

recommends.title: Incentivize Immediate Action
recommends.suggestion: Include a checkout button pointing directly to the cart, automatically applying the discount to minimize navigation friction.

recommends.title: Reduce Field Friction
recommends.suggestion: The form step is a major barrier, losing ${change}% of users. Remove non-essential fields (e.g., preferences, name) and focus on email collection alone.

recommends.title: Reinforce Incentives
recommends.suggestion: Remind users of their reward (e.g. 'Enter your email to receive your 10% coupon instantly') directly above the input box.
